१७: Ib. IV. ३३. १८-25.
Once when the Apsaras ladies, all daughters of Agni, were engaged in water sports in मानस, there came नारद. Without saluting him they asked him how to attain the Lord as husband. He gave them a व्रतम् but cursed that they would be sepa- rated from the Lord and become slaves of robbers; became the रेखस् on the body of वामन.
१८: M. ७०. २१-5; २४६. ५४.
--fourteen in number, the mindborn daughters of ब्रह्मा, daughters of Manu, etc. most of them were wives and mothers of gods and sages. वा. 9. ५५; ३०. ८७; ६९. ५३, ६२; ९६. २३५.
